content:
Nora: brightframe onboarding showing a big preflight spike during their staged rollout. Mobile app + background sync both hit preflight -> lots of 429s. Can someone triage?
Ethan: common. Probable causes: parallel init on app start, background sync refreshing ephemeral tokens aggressively, no x-client-id header so edge can't coalesce.
BrightFrame-Eng: they do a preflight on app cold-start, on resume, and from background sync every 20s. Token TTL is 60s.
Marta: immediate client-side fixes: 1) coalesce token fetches so one inflight per app process, 2) avoid background preflight if foreground tab/screen already warmed, 3) add x-client-id header with app instance id. Example coalesce pattern:
```js
let tokenInflight = null;
async function getToken(){
  if (tokenInflight) return tokenInflight;
  tokenInflight = fetch('/auth/ephemeral');
  try { return await tokenInflight; } finally { setTimeout(()=> tokenInflight=null, 45_000); }
}
```
Ethan: also recommend refresh only when age > 70% TTL to reduce churn. For background sync, check clients visibility or use a shared IndexedDB flag to avoid duplicate preflight from workers.
Nora: rolled patches to client and SW to debounce. Initial logs:
[2026-05-18T08:10:01Z] preflight brightframe-mobile-1 200
[2026-05-18T08:10:12Z] preflight brightframe-mobile-1 429
[2026-05-18T08:10:40Z] preflight brightframe-mobile-1 200 retry
Marta: good to hear. Ops-wise we can offer a 24h warmup throughput increase while they finish rollout. @OnboardBot can you open a warmup ticket for BRIGHT-ONB-81?
OnboardBot: Created ticket #BRIGHT-ONB-81: temporary warmup capacity (24h), owner: Ethan, ETA: 90m.
Ethan: one more ask - add x-client-id header like `x-client-id: brightframe-mobile-1` so edge attribution groups requests. Without it we apply per-IP shaping which is harsher.
BrightFrame-Eng: added header and deployed. After change 429s dropped dramatically.
Nora: CS handoff checklist to send customer: ["deploy token coalesce","defer SW preflight when app active","refresh only after 70% TTL","include x-client-id","monitor warmup BRIGHT-ONB-81 for 24h"]. I'll message them and close when stable for 2h.
Marta: offer a tiny SDK helper to opt-in coalescing if they want faster rollout.
Nora: thanks all, closing once BrightFrame confirms 2h stability. :thumbsup:
